title: The Remainder of a Giant Sum of Powers of Two | AMC 8-Style Level 5
description:
Add one, two, four, eight and keep doubling: a hundred numbers whose total is 31 digits long. Vantee shows how to find its remainder when divided by 7 in your head, two ways: spot the cycle of remainders, and the doubling trick. Then try a variant yourself!
